title: Oven Crispy Polish Bacon Skillet
description: A pungent and crispy Polish dish featuring bacon, perfect for a festive meal, cooked in a stone bowl to high protein standards.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onions, garlic, potatoes, and carrots to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
In a large stone bowl or oven-safe skillet, cook the bacon over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the bacon from the skillet and set aside, leaving the grease in the skillet.
Add the coated vegetables to the skillet and cook until they start to brown.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and create 6 wells in the vegetables, cracking an egg into each well.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over the top of the skillet.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake until the eggs are cooked through and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the skillet from the oven and top with the crispy bacon.
